title: Logic circuits
circuit: 1-bit full adder (G1..G5): S = A xor B xor Cin, Cout = A·B + Cin·(A xor B)

candidates.name: DigitalJS
candidates.oneLine: DigitalJS 0.14.2 as shipped, auto-laid-out full adder with clickable input buttons.
candidates.accuracy: All 8 rows read back through its API in the browser: 8/8 PASS against circuits/expected.json.
candidates.caveats: 2.3 MB bundle (jQuery, JointJS, ELK). Auto-layout differs from the figure. Phone: 1x, scrolls sideways in frame, small targets.

candidates.name: Logic (jppellet)
candidates.oneLine: The <logic-editor> web component in tryout mode, full adder hand-authored in its JSON5.
candidates.accuracy: All 8 rows set and read through its components in the browser: 8/8 PASS against circuits/expected.json.
candidates.caveats: Bundle fetches Bootstrap CSS from jsDelivr. Thin API, one maintainer. Zoomed to fit, so phone targets are about 10 px.

candidates.name: CircuitJS logic mode
candidates.oneLine: Falstad CircuitJS running circuits/logic/circuitjs.txt with L/H logic inputs and moving current dots.
candidates.accuracy: All 8 rows loaded with importCircuit, S and Cout node voltages read (0 V / 5 V): 8/8 PASS.
candidates.caveats: GPL-2.0. Slow to start (seconds). On a phone the drawing shrinks to tiny L/H targets. Red padlock icon shows.

candidates.name: Pad-native logic
candidates.oneLine: Inked SVG schematic, pen-drawn propagation, live truth table with red-pen ring, real-device glitch timing.
candidates.accuracy: check-pad-native-logic.mjs: 8 rows, 64 transitions in both modes, hazard timing, 20/20 PASS; same 16 row checks in the browser.
candidates.caveats: Gate delays are illustrative placeholders. Schematic coordinates hand-placed for this circuit; any new circuit needs a layout step.
